required_fix: Name archive periods as acceptance quarters in manifests and derive result quarter only from the SOI/submission period_end. Do not claim 2025Q4 coverage until an official archive containing period_end=2025-12-31 is discovered and checksummed.
root_cause: SEC BDC archive labels are filing-acceptance quarters, not investment position quarter ends. The 2025q4 archive contains filings accepted in 2025Q4 for positions through 2025-09-30. Positions at 2025-12-31 are filed in 2026Q1 and require a 2026q1 BDC archive, which was not linked by the official SEC index during Day 2. Therefore the Day 2 parser correctly produced 2025Q3 positions and zero 2025Q4 eligible nowcasts; downloading 2025q4 did not provide Q4 positions.
